    Shifts along a string #

    For a string w and a finite-dimensional module M, the pair functors at adjacent positions of w are isomorphic through the arrow of the letter between them (fiso_succ_true, fiso_succ_false). A map V → num_p inducing an isomorphism onto the pair functor at one position transfers to all positions along a compatible family (IsoOnto).

    w.sideSign S ⟨q + 1, ⋯⟩ = !S.en w.letters[q]
